name: Tip Ledger
one_liner: Drop a Telegram Desktop chat export (or paste one tip): every call is extracted, resolved, scored against exchange price history at day 3/30/60, checked for a pre-message run-up, frozen so a later delete cannot erase it, and optionally shadow-tracked instead of bought.
rides_on: src/store/portfolios.ts:33 named portfolio as the shadow book
new_parts: file/paste ingest surface (composer has no attachment path today)
regex-first tip parser (CMP/TGT/SL) with LLM residue pass
tips SQLite store: source, message ts, raw text, resolved instrument + band, price-at-tip, claims, checkpoints
wake-time checkpoint job (day 30/60/90) + notification
Tip Ledger panel with per-source scorecard and survivorship caveat
risk: A wrong symbol resolve yields a confident wrong verdict about a source the user trusts; mitigated by band-gated scoring, unresolved-listed-not-guessed, per-row receipts, user correction, arithmetic-only wording.

name: Operator Radar
one_liner: On wake, catch up the missed sessions from exchange daily archives and run deterministic manipulation-shape rules on held/watched names: trade-for-trade series migration, upper-band lock streaks, volume spikes, and price moves with a silent filings feed.
rides_on: sidecar/services/nse_bhavcopy.py:330 _fetch_day(day) for catch-up, :132 BhavRow.series, :129 volume, :120 throttle
new_parts: per-symbol 60-session ring in SQLite for holdings + watchlist only
delivery-% parse from the security-wise full bhavcopy (nse_bhavcopy.py:22,:95; BhavRow has no delivery field today)
admit SME series for watched symbols (dropped today at nse_bhavcopy.py:98)
POST /watch/sweep {symbols, since} called by the frontend on boot/focus
ASM/GSM/ESM surveillance-list lane (endpoint unverified)
rule engine + radar card; LLM narrates only fired rules
risk: False positives on genuine re-ratings teach a nervous user to sell winners; wording must stay 'shape + thresholds + rows', never 'manipulated'. Archive format change blinds it unless ingest health is visible.

name: Exit Door
one_liner: A per-holding liquidity glyph: days-to-exit at a sane participation rate, zero-volume session count, SME lot arithmetic, and the longest historical lower-band lock streak - the 'can I actually get out?' number no retail tool shows.
new_parts: days-to-exit + lock-streak calculation
glyph column + hover card in the portfolio panel
SME lot-size source (not in any bundled master today)
one read_handler capability so the agent can answer 'can I get out of X?'
risk: Reads as a sell signal; it is a property of the market for the stock, not a view on the company. A stale lot size must degrade to unknown, never a wrong count.

name: I Noticed You Bought
one_liner: Diff successive read-only holdings snapshots, ask one line of 'why' for each new position, freeze the world-state at that moment, and return months later with a review of the user's own decisions - reasons given vs returns.
rides_on: src/store/portfolios.ts (manual diff source without a broker)
sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:617 get_corporate_actions (a bonus is not a buy)
new_parts: holdings_snapshots + decisions SQLite store
gap-tolerant, corporate-action-aware diff
ask-card (one per new name, dismissible forever)
periodic decision-review brief
risk: Nagging. Also Kite's daily token expiry makes snapshots irregular, so the diff must never misread a gap or a corporate action as a trade. No order surface is touched.

name: Calm Protocol
one_liner: When a holding falls hard, run a fixed five-check triage in under a minute (filing today? peers? index? volume? radar?), say 'market' or 'company' with receipts, and quote back the selling rule the user wrote when calm.
new_parts: drop trigger on held symbols
deterministic checklist runner (tool calls, not free reasoning)
typed 'my rules' field in the workspace blob (four-call-site rule)
notification intents generalised beyond workflow runs
triage card with check timestamps
risk: Calling it 'the market' minutes before a company filing lands; the card must carry its check time and re-run on the next TTL. Only works while the app is open - must say so.

name: The Crowd Arrived
one_liner: Parse shareholder COUNTS (not just percentages) out of the quarterly shareholding XBRL and flag the distribution picture: retail holders multiplying while promoters and large holders shrink - with the three filings as receipts.
rides_on: sidecar/models/announcements.py:82-138 ShareholdingPattern (no count field; xbrl_url at :124)
docs/redesign/verification/r15/census/world/fey-tijori-trendlyne.md O-7 (4-quarter pledge/promoter derivative shares the card)
new_parts: holder-count XBRL fact parse (concept name to be read off a real filing)
optional model fields + types/ mirror in the same commit
conjunction rule (holders up AND insiders down) + ownership card
risk: A legitimate re-rating also grows the holder base; only the conjunction is a signal and both legs must be shown. XBRL taxonomy revisions must degrade to 'count unavailable'.

name: Seven Pages
one_liner: A guided first read of an annual report for someone who has never opened one: the seven sections a professional reads first, each finding pinned to a PDF page that opens on click, with one-line explanations of terms the user has not met yet - and never twice.
new_parts: annual-report mode: whole-document section finder with per-paragraph page numbers (today capped at 60 pages / 15 MB / 6 kept: extract.py:65,:51,:68)
annual-report locator per scrip (endpoint unverified)
url#page=N receipts via the granted shell open
learnedTerms map in the workspace blob
quote-is-on-that-page verification before emitting a receipt
risk: An off-by-one page (PDF index vs printed folio) destroys the receipt's credibility; scanned micro-cap reports defeat text extraction and must say so per page.

name: While You Were Away
one_liner: The app opens to a brief instead of a blank composer: filings on your holdings since a per-symbol last-seen cursor, routine ones collapsed, the one that matters opened, plus due tip checkpoints, radar flags and results-day prep.
rides_on: sidecar/services/research/disclosures.py:50,:61 headline regexes, :185 fetch_results_calendar (no UI surface today per census TS-5)
new_parts: per-symbol last-seen cursor in the workspace blob (none exists today)
deterministic routine-filing classifier with a visible 'unclassified' bucket
wake brief card
wake-driven scheduled intents ('prep me the evening before results')
risk: Filing a material item under 'routine'; bias to over-surface and never hide the routine list. BSE's 30-day window (corporate_disclosures.py:88) and 50-row limit (:71) silently truncate long absences unless stated.
